limitations: This verifies extraction objects/history and source preservation during this invocation, not standalone builds, generated freshness or paired consumer behavior.
An optional root HEAD baseline detects HEAD movement since that checkpoint; pre-invocation index/worktree preservation needs a separately captured byte/mode baseline.
Source preservation includes tracked and nonignored untracked root worktree files, refs, index entries and worktree registry; ignored bytes and other worktrees' content are not inventoried.
Only the exact .history-support/ namespace is excluded from the final active manifest; all of its historical/current projected tree entries are nevertheless compared.

A bare export has no checkout to inspect; its complete committed active tree is still verified. Historical blob identities/modes are compared in every projected snapshot; current selected blob payloads are rehashed.
Source history is shallow. Verification covers exactly the available fixed-source ancestry; unavailable pre-cutoff history, including earlier LICENSE history, is not established.

samples.detail: commit map does not cover exactly fixed-source ancestry
